jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Perfect Casting
jokes.joke: My family made me attend a murder-mystery dinner and cast me as the victim. Honestly, it was the best role I’ve ever had at a family gathering: I got to lie down, stop talking, and still be praised for participating.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: The Niagara Tour Guide
jokes.joke: I took a bus tour of Niagara Falls, and our guide was way too flirtatious for a man narrating a natural disaster. Every five minutes: 'And on your left, ladies, six million gallons a minute — kinda like me, I never stop flowing.' Ma'am, I came for geology, not to be seduced by a man in a poncho. The waterfall was less thunderous than his confidence.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Cave Tour
jokes.joke: I took a guided tour through a cavern, and ninety minutes underground really breaks down a man’s spirit. At one point the guide hit a switch, plunged us into total pitch-black darkness, and whispered, 'Now, listen to the silence.' And all I could think was, if someone stabs this guy right now, there is simply no way any jury convicts the rest of us.

jokes.label: Joke D

jokes.title: Mandatory Mystery Night
jokes.joke: My company forced attendance at a team-building murder mystery. So there I am at this whodunit, holding a plastic dagger and accusing Bob from accounting, when it finally hits me: the real crime isn’t the poisoned canapés. It’s whoever thought making us do this would improve morale.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Suspicious Falls
jokes.joke: I went to see this huge waterfall, and the tour guide acted like we were investigating a crime scene. He kept asking, “Notice anything… unusual?” I’m drenched, starving, and he’s squinting at me like I stole the river. Finally he whispers, “If the culprit is among us, speak now.” I said, “If it’s me, can I confess somewhere dry?”
